themes.name: Midnight
themes.usage: True black for dark rooms and OLED screens: Studio's colours on blacker grounds, text a touch dimmer.

themes.name: High contrast
themes.usage: Black grounds, white text, strong lines and brighter accents - for bright rooms, dim screens and weaker eyesight.

themes.name: Paper
themes.usage: Daylight gone warm: cream grounds and brown-black ink, low in blue light for long sessions.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Ground: the top bar, ruler, display wells and meter channels.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panels: arrangement lanes, the device area, editors. The surface most of the app sits on.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Controls at rest and track headers.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: An ON / selected state: toggled buttons, the selected segment, the selected track, node or menu item. Coloured rather than a grey step, so it reads without looking for it. Currently the blue accent.

tokens.name: active-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind an active/selected thing, with active-coloured text or edge.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: A card sitting on a recessed well (the Effects Board's nodes on its bg-000 canvas). bg-200 in Studio; bg-100 in Daylight, where bg-200 is nearly the same tone as bg-000 and cards would vanish into the well.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states, knob tracks, fader caps, pad faces.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: The strongest neutral step. No longer used for ON states - those use active / active-soft, which are easier to spot.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: between panels, rows and device sections. Grouping is done with these and with space, never with boxed cards.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of buttons, segmented controls, knob caps and readouts (3:1 against bg-100 and bg-200).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons, knob value arcs, display lines, the playhead, selection outlines.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units and secondary text, on bg-000 to bg-300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tick marks, grid glyphs, disabled icons. Never text that must be read.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Sound is happening: the play button while running, playing clips' play glyph and progress, sounding notes, held pads, the meter up to -12 dB. Nothing else.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for a playing scene or a sounding row. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Record, arm, recording clips, the clip LED. Told apart from signal by glyph (circle vs triangle) as well as colour.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a record fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Solo, and the meter from -12 to 0 dB.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill.

tokens.name: mod
tokens.usage: Modulation only: modulator chips, modulation rings on knobs, modulation ranges on displays, the loop range.

tokens.name: on-mod
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mod fill.

tokens.name: mod-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of modulator chips and modulation ranges on displays.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px, offset 2px. An alias of ink.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: The playhead line and its ruler triangle. An alias of ink: position is information, not state.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Time-selection wash over lanes and the root-row wash in the piano roll. Sits under clips.

tokens.name: grid-bar
tokens.usage: Bar lines in timelines and editors. An alias of line in Daylight; a touch brighter than line in Studio, where a light line on a dark ground reads fainter than the same contrast ratio does the other way round.

tokens.name: grid-beat
tokens.usage: Beat and sixteenth lines: present, quieter than bar lines.

tokens.name: clip-coral
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour (clay). Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-amber
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour (ochre). Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-teal
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour (sage). Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-blue
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour (slate). Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-violet
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour (lilac). Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: clip-pink
tokens.usage: Clip and track colour (rose). Always with on-clip text.

tokens.name: on-clip
tokens.usage: Clip names, glyphs, waveforms and notes drawn on any clip colour, in both themes.

tokens.name: clip-coral-line
tokens.usage: The clip-coral track colour as a line: knob value arcs on that track's devices and mixer strip. Darker in Daylight so the arc holds 3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: clip-amber-line
tokens.usage: The clip-amber track colour as a line: knob value arcs on that track's devices and mixer strip. Darker in Daylight so the arc holds 3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: clip-teal-line
tokens.usage: The clip-teal track colour as a line: knob value arcs on that track's devices and mixer strip. Darker in Daylight so the arc holds 3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: clip-blue-line
tokens.usage: The clip-blue track colour as a line: knob value arcs on that track's devices and mixer strip. Darker in Daylight so the arc holds 3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: clip-violet-line
tokens.usage: The clip-violet track colour as a line: knob value arcs on that track's devices and mixer strip. Darker in Daylight so the arc holds 3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: clip-pink-line
tokens.usage: The clip-pink track colour as a line: knob value arcs on that track's devices and mixer strip. Darker in Daylight so the arc holds 3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: clip-edge
tokens.usage: A 1px inner edge on clips so muted clip colours hold their shape on the light theme.

tokens.name: key-white
tokens.usage: Natural keys on keyboard strips. Held keys switch to signal.

tokens.name: key-black
tokens.usage: Sharp keys on keyboard strips; darker than key-white in both themes.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Shor Symbols", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: One family, four sizes (11, 12, 13, 15). Hierarchy comes from weight and colour, not from more sizes. Mono is for code (the Faust editor) only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Splash, onboarding and the cover. Never inside the workspace.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Device section titles, track names, panel titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag a modulator onto any control to route it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control names, in sentence case. No uppercase, no letter-spacing.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Values under knobs, grid numbers, metadata. Plex figures are tabular by default, so values never jitter.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Transport tempo, meter and position: the numbers read from across the room.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside controls: icon to label, meter channel gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Section padding inside a device; knob column gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between control groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between device sections when there is room; cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Settings and onboarding layout.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Clips, notes, meters, fader caps, pads.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, readouts, display wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the device frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Modulator chips only, so modulation reads as its own kind of object.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, segmented controls and readouts.

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar.

tokens.name: size-clip
tokens.usage: Session clip slot and scene row height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Compact track header height (session view).

tokens.name: size-knob-sm
tokens.usage: Trims and secondary controls: mixer pan, fine tune, key tracking.

tokens.name: size-knob
tokens.usage: The default knob.

tokens.name: size-knob-lg
tokens.usage: The one control a device is played with (Carve: Cutoff). At most two per device.

tokens.name: size-lane
tokens.usage: Default arrangement lane height; the header matches it.

tokens.name: size-lane-auto
tokens.usage: Automation lane height.

tokens.name: size-ruler
tokens.usage: Ruler height in the arrangement and editors.

tokens.name: size-track-head
tokens.usage: Width of the arrangement track-header column.

tokens.name: size-ed-head
tokens.usage: Width of the row-label / side column in clip editors.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus only. Panels are flat.
